metadata.title: Compactness of Cone Yang-Mills Connections
metadata.abstract: We consider the cone Yang-Mills functional recently introduced by Tseng and Zhou. This functional generalizes the Yang-Mills functional by coupling it to a closed 2-form which can represent a geometric structure of interest, e.g. a symplectic form or Ricci form. While the perspective of dimensional reduction is not always possible, we show that a cone Yang-Mills field is always locally the dimensional reduction of a pure Yang-Mills field. We then prove a monotonicity formula and use the dimensional reduction framework to prove an $\epsilon$-regularity theorem in two ways. Finally, we prove a compactness theorem for sequences of cone Yang-Mills connections with bounded action and $L^p$-bounded Higgs fields. Away from a singular set of codimension at least 4 and after suitable bundle identifications, the sequence subconverges in the $C^\infty_{\operatorname{loc}}$-topology.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 锥 Yang–Mills 联络的紧致性
analysis.workSummary: 把 cone Yang–Mills 场局部实现为圆柱上的普通 Yang–Mills 场，建立带指数修正的能量单调性及 ε 正则性。对 n≥4、一级有界几何、闭二形式 C¹ 有界的底空间，能量与任意固定 q>0 的 Higgs Lq 范数一致有界的连接列，在适当丛识别后于奇异集外光滑局部收敛。
techniques: 丛同构拼接与椭圆正则性
analysis.breakthrough: 无需闭二形式的整体整性即可获得局部 YM 工具和余维至少四的连接紧致性。
analysis.limitations: 紧致性主定理要求紧结构群、n≥4、非零闭二形式C¹有界及Higgs Lq控制；允许改变极限丛，收敛避开有限H^(n−4)测度的能量集中集。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。全部 PDF 页面完整提取并通过既有 AI 关键词及 GenAI、Doubao、Fable、Kimi、Danus、Prism、WorkBuddy 补充检索；未检出作者使用 AI 的披露。

analysis.priorityReason: 几何规范理论的正则性和极限结构较完整
